question: On the ship, what happens if I enter a running-hours reading lower than the component's current hours when completing a work order?
claim: Normal entry: The completion is refused with “Running hours cannot go backward!” The component’s counter is not reduced.

evidence.doc: Technical - Ship-Side (Vessel Crew) Operational Notes
evidence.section: 1.1.13.2 Completing Work Orders on the Ship — Current Rules
evidence.best_sentence: * A reading lower than the component's current hours is refused ('Running hours cannot go backward!').

evidence.doc: Technical - Recent Updates & Changed Behaviours (Operational) Notes
evidence.section: 1.1.14.3 Running Hours Never Move Backwards
evidence.best_sentence: * A component's running-hours counter is never reduced by a late, low or out-of-order reading from any source (ship entry, office entry, work-order completion or sync).

evidence.doc: Technical - Recent Updates & Changed Behaviours (Operational) Notes
evidence.section: 1.1.14.2 Completing a Running-Hours Work Order Requires a Reading
evidence.best_sentence: * When completing a work order for a job based on running hours, the running-hours reading at completion is mandatory — the completion is refused without it.

question: On the ship, what happens if I enter a running-hours reading lower than the component's current hours when completing a work order?
claim: The reading is kept on the work order and in the audit history for scheduling, but the component’s counter is not changed.

evidence.doc: Technical - Ship-Side (Vessel Crew) Operational Notes
evidence.section: 1.1.13.2 Completing Work Orders on the Ship — Current Rules
evidence.best_sentence: The one exception is a back-dated entry: if the reading date you enter is earlier than the date of the component's current reading, the completion is saved and the reading is kept on the work order for scheduling, but the component's counter is not changed.

evidence.doc: Technical - Recent Updates & Changed Behaviours (Operational) Notes
evidence.section: 1.1.14.3 Running Hours Never Move Backwards
evidence.best_sentence: A lower reading entered directly is refused; a lower reading that is back-dated is kept in the audit history and on the work order without changing the counter.

evidence.doc: Technical - Recent Updates & Changed Behaviours (Operational) Notes
evidence.section: 1.1.14.2 Completing a Running-Hours Work Order Requires a Reading
evidence.best_sentence: * The reading is recorded on the work order together with the outcome of applying it (whether it updated the component's counter, or was kept on record without changing the counter — see the next item).
